**subgraph-registry v0.9.14**

- Adds full support for official graphops/subgraph-mcp tool names: execute and live-schema tools are now available and opt-in, matching the official interface.
- Discovery tools never execute network queries; live querying requires setting a Studio API key and is explicit.
- Every discovery result now ships with 30-day query volume (`query_volume_30d`)—no round-trip needed for query counts.
- Clear separation between discovery (offline/local) and execute (online/network/key) tools.
- Updated documentation reflects improved tool parity, new opt-in routes, and strict separation of network behavior.
- Minor files cleaned up; new test for execute/query routes added.
